title: Job search: Japanese staffing and employment
description: Synthetic job-search vocabulary for Japanese employment listings. All examples are illustrative sampling seeds, not verified vacancies. Missing evidence must not be inferred.

x-adaptgym.scope: Synthetic Japan / JPY job-search benchmark; no partner feed data

job_title.description: Actual position title, preserving specializations; do not replace it with a promotional feed headline.
job_title.title: the kind of job you want

category_breadcrumb.description: Partner breadcrumb as a single normalized path; equality compares the full path, not ancestors.
examples: Kyoto / Temporary staffing / General office work

location_country.description: ISO country code explicitly supplied by the listing.

location_region.description: Normalized prefecture name; examples are sampling seeds, not an exhaustive vocabulary.
location_region.title: the prefecture

location_locality.description: Normalized municipality and ward; keep compatible with the region when constructing listings.
location_locality.title: the city or ward

short_description.description: Concise factual summary from the full page or JSON-LD description. A workweek alone is not a job summary.

employer_name.description: Actual employer, when explicitly identified; unspecified otherwise. Keep the employer distinct from a recruiting or staffing agency.

staffing_agency.description: Recruiting or staffing organization, distinct from the client employer.

salary_hourly_jpy.description: Explicitly advertised hourly pay in JPY. If quoted as a range or lower bound, retain the guaranteed lower endpoint; omit when unknown. Never derive it from monthly pay.
salary_hourly_jpy.title: hourly pay in JPY

salary_monthly_jpy.description: Explicitly advertised monthly pay in JPY; retain the lower endpoint of a range or lower-bound quote. Omit if not stated; do not convert hourly pay.

employment_type.description: Normalized illustrative employment categories, kept distinct from hours worked.
employment_type.title: the employment contract type

working_days_pattern.description: Explicit workweek pattern; unspecified if missing. A weekday schedule alone does not establish intraday hours.

days_per_week.description: Explicit number of working days each week; omit if unknown.
days_per_week.title: working days per week

work_start_minute.description: Local start time as minutes after midnight, e.g. 540 = 09:00. Omit when unknown.
work_start_minute.title: the earliest acceptable start time

work_end_minute.description: Local end time as minutes after midnight, e.g. 1060 = 17:40. Omit when unknown. Overnight shifts need explicit handling outside this schema.
work_end_minute.title: the latest acceptable finish time

working_minutes_per_day.description: Explicit paid/actual daily working duration, not a duration inferred from clock times. Preserve source discrepancies for review.

break_minutes_per_day.description: Explicit break duration; omit if not stated.

shorter_hours_negotiable.description: Whether the listing explicitly permits discussing shorter hours. Missing evidence is unspecified.
shorter_hours_negotiable.title: whether reduced hours must be negotiable

work_arrangement.description: Explicit work arrangement. remote_negotiable means work from home can be discussed, not guaranteed remote or hybrid work. Never infer on-site from an occupation.
work_arrangement.title: where you need to work

minimum_experience_months.description: Explicit minimum required experience; omit when unknown. Do not translate an occupation label into a numeric requirement.
minimum_experience_months.title: experience required by the job, in months

experience_specialization.description: Explicit required experience, separate from duration. unspecified if missing.
examples: English correspondence and executive secretarial support

skill_word.description: Microsoft Word: required only when explicitly required; mentioned for tools or development environment without a stated requirement; not_required only for an explicit negation; unspecified when absent. Multiple skill fields may be set independently.

skill_english.title: whether the job should require English

overtime_max_hours.description: Explicit advertised maximum overtime. Interpret only together with overtime_reference_period; do not assume a reference period when one is absent.
overtime_max_hours.title: the maximum acceptable overtime hours

overtime_reference_period.description: Period explicitly attached to the overtime limit; unspecified when the listing does not establish it.
overtime_reference_period.title: the period for that overtime limit

public_holidays_off.description: Whether public holidays are explicitly days off; keep distinct from weekends.
public_holidays_off.title: whether public holidays should be days off
